items.title: The geometrically connected fibre locus of a morphism is stable under arbitrary base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For any morphism f : X -> Y and any base change g : Y' -> Y with projection f' : X' -> Y', the subset of Y' where the fibres of f' are geometrically connected equals the inverse image under g of the corresponding subset of Y. The retained proof is written out: it reduces to the assertion that X'_{y'} = X_y x_y y' is geometrically connected over kappa(y') iff X_y is geometrically connected over kappa(y), concluding by the Varieties lemma that geometric connectedness is checked after arbitrary field extension. Retained author proof at lines 7895-7902.
